Animantarx ("Living fortress") was a planteating, armoured dinosaur (Ankylosauria, Nodosauridae) from the Cretaceous period of North America.
Animantarx ( Name means "Living fortress " ) was a planteating dinosaur from North America of the cretaceous period. It was a nodosaurid, with spikes on it's shoulders and bony bumps on the back.
Skeletal cast of Animantarx ramaljonesi. On display at the USU Eastern Prehistoric Museum, Price, Utah (US).
